conditions.title: Registration & Conditions
conditions.p1: There is one exhibition area – Velké náměstí, Prachatice with a capacity of up to 100 vehicles. Selection of vehicles for approval will take place.
conditions.p2: All registrations are responded to by email. Once your registration for Salty Road Meet is approved, you will receive a confirmation email with instructions for paying the registration fee.
conditions.feeList3: Welcome package from Salty Road Meet and our partners
conditions.p3: After payment is received, we will send you your registration confirmation with a registration number (needed for accreditation) and complete exhibitor instructions.

fee.title: Registration Fee
fee.p1: The registration fee must be paid in advance via bank transfer as confirmation of your participation.
fee.refund1: If canceled up to 14 days before the event: Full refund
fee.refund2: If canceled less than 14 days before the event: Non-refundable
